out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Fell, passed out; 'The pain ceased. I immediately found myself in a dark cave or mine-like tunnel.'

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Dark cave or mine-like tunnel; ramp at the end.
tunnel.movement_other_detail: No explicit motion through the tunnel described; later guided through a rock-like wall by a hand on the left shoulder.

arrival.other_being_detail: Silhouetted human-looking figures with 'a bad sort of energy'; a young short lady in black and white who smiled and said 'go back'; later a guiding male hand with cuffed sleeve 'like perhaps Jesus would have worn'; later 5-6 translucent adult male figures around a glowing orb; later millions of infant-sized beings on a beach; voices asking questions.

environment.environment_other_detail: Mine-like tunnel with fires; cloud-like pearly boundary around a bright area; half-buried golden glowing orb emitting whitish rays; larger beautiful area with rays to pearly billowy clouds; black sky with rolling hills of blue glasslike turf and a golden road; mile-long beach with storm-like dark gray clouds and an endless void beyond.

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: Explicit instruction: 'go back, you don't have to come up here!' Later, felt compelled to accept 'my question' and flew into darkness leading to a birth process.
boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Return framed as being compelled to accept a 'question', flying into a void, then undergoing a birth process and later waking on the lawn.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Fell from a tree, landed on back, 'passed out.'

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Pre-birth/birth-process sequence: infant-sized beings on a beach; questions about being born into circumstances; compelled acceptance; void; then 'birth process' and waking back in backyard.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Tunnel with figures and instruction to go back; guided through wall into orb/light area; repeated 'worthiness' questions with displacement; landscape with golden road; beach with infant-sized beings and pre-birth selection questions; flight into void; birth process; then waking in backyard.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Repeated evaluative question: 'Are you worthy of this level of existence?' asked at least twice, each time followed by removal to another place.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Explicit pre-birth selection-like scene: millions of infant-sized beings on a beach; a voice asking questions such as 'Who wants to be born of alcoholic parents?' with beings flying into a dark abyss; experiencer later compelled to accept 'my question' and then underwent a 'birth process' before waking back in the same life context.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: ‘go back, you don't have to come up here!’; ‘are you worthy of this level of existence?’; ‘Who wants to be born of alcoholic parents?’; ‘No, not me,’; ‘no, no, no!’
